inputs.text: [excited] It was 12 meters long — as long as a school bus! [quickly] Standing up, it was 4.5 meters tall — as tall as a double-decker bus! [serious] And it weighed 5,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as an elephant!
[amazed] A little lighter than T. rex?
[confident] A little lighter. [proud] But plenty enough to rule the Gobi Desert.
